purpose: Fallback macro fingerprints for current holdings that are not yet present in data/macro-sensitivities.json, plus the holdings live-score policy. Canonical macro-sensitivities always take precedence when a ticker exists there.

liveScorePolicy.note: Fundamentals are never overwritten. Macro and Developing Themes are separate overlays worth at most five score points each.

fallbackMacroProfiles.name: ExxonMobil
fallbackMacroProfiles.profileNote: Integrated upstream/refining cash flows are most sensitive to crude and refined-product tightness; broad macro demand is secondary.

financialConditions.rationale: Discount rates matter less than commodity cash flows.

creditAvailability.rationale: Balance-sheet strength limits dependence on credit.

consumerStrength.rationale: Consumer mobility affects fuel demand at the margin.

riskAppetite.rationale: Equity risk appetite is a minor valuation input.

crudeTightness.rationale: Higher crude realizations directly lift upstream cash generation.

productTightness.rationale: Tighter diesel/gasoline markets support refining margins.

gasTightness.rationale: Gas pricing contributes to integrated upstream economics.

tailCreditStress.rationale: Weak-end credit stress can pressure broad equity multiples but not core solvency.

fallbackMacroProfiles.name: CTOS Digital Berhad
fallbackMacroProfiles.profileNote: Credit-data demand benefits from healthy lending and transaction activity; weak-end stress is mixed because screening demand can rise as volumes soften.

growthDemand.rationale: Business formation and transaction activity support data demand.

policyRelief.rationale: Lower discount rates support growth valuations.

financialConditions.rationale: Easier financing supports lending activity and valuation.

creditAvailability.rationale: Healthy credit creation expands screening and analytics volumes.

housingStrength.rationale: Housing transactions are a secondary credit-data driver.

riskAppetite.rationale: Risk appetite primarily affects the multiple.

tailCreditStress.rationale: Screening demand can rise, but severe stress hurts credit volumes and valuation.

fallbackMacroProfiles.name: IOI Properties Group Berhad
fallbackMacroProfiles.profileNote: A leveraged property and investment-property group is highly exposed to long-end financing conditions, credit availability and property demand.

growthDemand.rationale: Economic growth supports sales, rents and occupancy.

financialConditions.rationale: High leverage makes financing costs a primary earnings and NAV variable.

creditAvailability.rationale: Project funding and buyer financing depend on healthy credit markets.

housingStrength.rationale: Property-cycle strength directly supports development sales.

labourStrength.rationale: Employment is a secondary housing-demand input.

riskAppetite.rationale: Risk appetite affects discounts to NAV.

tailCreditStress.rationale: Weak-end credit stress is adverse for leveraged property exposures.

fallbackMacroProfiles.name: Take-Two Interactive Software
fallbackMacroProfiles.profileNote: The business is driven primarily by consumer discretionary spending and franchise execution, with macro mostly affecting demand and valuation rather than solvency.

growthDemand.rationale: Broad growth modestly supports entertainment spend.

policyRelief.rationale: Lower discount rates mainly support the valuation multiple.

financialConditions.rationale: Financing conditions are secondary to franchise economics.

creditAvailability.rationale: Credit availability is a minor market input.

consumerStrength.rationale: Consumer discretionary capacity supports game and recurrent-spend demand.

inputCostPressure.rationale: Wage and development-cost inflation can pressure margins.

riskAppetite.rationale: Risk appetite affects the multiple paid for future franchise cash flows.

tailCreditStress.rationale: Severe household/market stress is negative for discretionary spend and valuation.

fallbackMacroProfiles.name: Green Packet Berhad
fallbackMacroProfiles.profileNote: A speculative small-cap with weak current fundamentals is unusually sensitive to financing conditions, weak-end credit stress and equity risk appetite.

growthDemand.rationale: Better activity can support technology-services demand.

policyRelief.rationale: Easing expectations can help speculative valuations.

financialConditions.rationale: Funding conditions matter heavily for weak-cash-flow small caps.

creditAvailability.rationale: Access to capital is a key survival and dilution variable.

consumerStrength.rationale: Consumer demand is a secondary operating input.

industrialCapex.rationale: Digital infrastructure spending can support some business lines.

riskAppetite.rationale: Speculative equity appetite strongly affects the share-price environment.

tailCreditStress.rationale: Weak-end credit stress is directly adverse to speculative funding conditions.
